title: Finite quotient and site comparisons of shifted root lines
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a scheme $X$ on which $\ell$ is invertible, and $m,d\ge0$. Use the finite root powers of [def-coefficient-twists-detailed] and the actual derived quotient comparison of [def-sf-orientation-finite-reduction-comparisons]. Realize intrinsic finite modules as fixed-coefficient pro-etale modules by the scalar-unit-normalized realization equivalence of [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. For every $r\ge0$ with $\ell^{r+1}A_{E,m+1}=0$, the comparison from the ordinary etale root line of [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback] under the etale-to-pro-etale pullback [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback] to the reduced shifted line is the tensor-power root comparison of [lem-pur-vector-integration-site-comparison], followed by the canonical single-complex shift comparison, fixed-scalar realization, and the inverse derived quotient comparison. Every ordinary fixed-scalar comparison is specified on all local scalar-unit sections. No arbitrary realization isomorphism is input.
